name: Unishire Urban Infra Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1991, Unishire Urban Infra Ltd is in the business of real estate development and 
investments.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
UUIL is in the infrastructure business involving construction projects in different sectors like roads, rails, ports, irrigation, power, etc. It has undertaken real estate projects in Bangalore.
Apart from this, the company deals with and invest its surplus funds in shares and mutual funds.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.22 times its book value

Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
